summary: 锂盐产品必须区分工业级/电池级碳酸锂、单水氢氧化锂等规格，吨产能和价格不可跨等级直接比较。

summary: 锂盐转换产能的有效供给受杂质控制、重结晶/纯化和客户认证影响，首次产出碳酸锂并不等于达到电池级稳定量产。
why_search_may_miss_it: 项目新闻爱用‘投产’，客户合格率和品质爬坡很少公开。

recalled_details.gap_reason: earlier overseas converter ramp was case-based; product-grade qualification needs reusable capacity semantics

lithium carbonate battery grade qualification impurity ramp

summary: 碳酸锂市场需要区分现货、长协、期货、仓单和矿石/云母自供成本；期货上市后不同价格信号的领先/滞后关系可能改变交易行为。
why_search_may_miss_it: 不同价格被媒体都称‘锂价’，且期货出现改变了价格发现结构。

recalled_details.gap_reason: corrective pass mentioned futures, but multi-price-market semantics and basis were not explicit

summary: 锂精矿、锂云母、盐湖卤水到碳酸锂的单位原料耗用和回收率差异很大，吨锂盐成本不能只按原料价格比较。
why_search_may_miss_it: 成本报告常直接给现金成本，不保留原料单耗/回收率vintage。

recalled_details.gap_reason: feedstock route differences were known, but material-intensity conversion factors were not formalized
recalled_details.schema_implication: chemical cost model needs feedstock_type × unit_consumption × recovery

lithium carbonate spodumene consumption recovery lepidolite
disconfirmation_queries: lithium carbonate feedstock routes have same unit consumption/recovery

summary: 锂云母提锂会产生大量锂渣/固废，环保处置能力、渣场和地方监管可能形成独立于矿石资源的有效产能约束。
why_search_may_miss_it: 产能/矿量数据不记录固废处置，环保事件多在地方政府文件。

recalled_details.gap_reason: lepidolite environmental issue was recalled, but waste-disposal capacity as a reusable bottleneck was not explicit

lepidolite lithium slag disposal capacity Yichun
disconfirmation_queries: lepidolite chemical output independent of waste disposal capacity

summary: 锂盐厂可能同时拥有自有矿权益、包销矿和外采现货，不同原料来源在同一时期对应完全不同成本；公司平均成本会掩盖边际外购矿利润。
why_search_may_miss_it: 财报只给综合成本，边际外采成本和自供比例需要多来源拼接。

disconfirmation_queries: converter average cost fully represents marginal external-feedstock economics
